input._script:
using JSON3
out = Dict{String,Any}()
try
    import Pkg
    using CUDA
    import JACC
    out["jacc_loaded"] = string(pkgversion(JACC)); out["jacc_path"] = pathof(JACC)
    out["cuda_jl"] = string(pkgversion(CUDA)); out["backend"] = string(JACC.default_backend())
    out["precompile_ok"] = try Pkg.precompile(); true catch e; string(e) end
    out["jacc_dirs"] = readdir(joinpath(first(Base.DEPOT_PATH), "packages", "JACC"))
catch e
    out["error"] = first(sprint(showerror, e, catch_backtrace()), 1500)
end
println(JSON3.write(out))
